name: Mizumoto Shizuka
source:
Zodiac: Capricorn

A typical young lady whose parents used to be presidents of a large company. A year ago her father's company went bankrupt. As a result the whole Mizumoto family was forced to live in poverty. 
Due to Shizuka being raised as a young lady, she was sheltered from the outside world. which rendered her to be severely ignorant, she knows nothing about sexual education and her wariness of strangers is almost zero. That has to be pretty dangerous...

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20031014071144/http://www.pinkpineapple.co.jp/pinpai/xmas/character/character.html]official website[/url].]
